name: LSC Smart Connect Mood Light (Action 3204432)
description: RGB + 3000K mood light sold by Action. Standard v2 data points, plus 25 scene_data, 27 music_data and 42 (built-in microphone config), which OmaMood leaves alone. No colour temperature DP: white is fixed at 3000K.
notes: Writing 24 (colour) switches the lamp to colour mode by itself, so the mode is written last.
A single CONTROL that changes the mode together with other data points is ignored: one DP per message.
Writing 42 (mic config) leaves the lamp in work_mode 'music'; OmaMood never writes it.
28 (control_data) with change mode 0 switches instantly; 24 fades over ~0.5 s. Blinks use 28.

tested.model: LSC Smart Mood Light RGB+WW, article 3204432 (Action)
